scope: Democratic institutional, prior-office, candidate-supplied questionnaire and endorsing-organization profiles already acquired, plus the eleven official candidate profiles. These source families were read before further discovery. Other campaign/directory profiles are not blanket-approved.

coding_holds.219872: Completed bachelor's and law degrees are explicit, but the law-degree type is unspecified; do not assume JD.
coding_holds.219956: College graduation is explicit; formal credential level remains unspecified.
coding_holds.219755: Institutions and fields of study do not establish completed degrees.
coding_holds.220448: Attendance only, not a completed credential.
coding_holds.220538: School list only, not a completed credential.
coding_holds.220698: Voter-guide bachelor's claim conflicts with the professional profile's associate-level account. Preserve both, without choosing the higher claim.
coding_holds.220950: Both questionnaire accounts support BA and teaching master's completion. Preserve the subject-wording conflict; it does not negate agreement on credential level.
coding_holds.221333: Completed degree of unspecified level; pre-law certificate is not a law degree.
coding_holds.140483: Graduation is explicit but degree titles are not. Do not infer JD from law-school attendance/graduation alone.
coding_holds.221234: Public-school graduation does not establish a particular diploma level.

incumbency_hold_policy: The other 37 lack a unique federal-service person bridge. A different member in the same district and absent name matches do not alone establish nonincumbency. Preserve these holds.
qualification_policy: Qualify literal factual observations separately from completed-attainment coding, paid employment, election-day timing, and contrast estimability. Source status alone neither qualifies nor rejects a claim. Retrospective acquisition remains prospectively ineligible.
negative_history_review: No explicit never-served responses were found in held Democratic military, prior-office or government-history fields. Blank questionnaire fields and candidate-did-not-provide responses are not negatives.

rejected_matches.reason: Ray Pooley's voter guide says work/military information was not provided; this is not nonservice.
Opelika's Lee McInnis assistant-city-engineer record lacks a bridge to the AL-03 candidate whose held source reports a communications background. Do not merge a same-name government employee.
A partisan commentary's assertion of no previous office is not a candidate questionnaire or sufficient primary evidence; AmeriCorps is not military service.
